title: Oil Nears $100 After Attacks Hit Saudi Energy Facilities | The Pulse 9/8/2026
description:
Brent oil approached $100 a barrel after Saudi Arabia said operations at several energy facilities in the kingdom’s south were halted by attacks. 

Canada imposed tariffs of 15% to 50% on hundreds of products from the US, as Prime Minister Mark Carney bets that standing up to President Donald Trump will eventually help Ottawa’s negotiating position with its biggest trading partner.

Bloomberg has learned Anthropic has decided against acquiring artificial intelligence startup Decart AI. Sources say Anthropic had been exploring a deal and performed due diligence on Decart, but ultimately walked away.

Today's guests: Jens Eisenschmidt, Morgan Stanley Chief European Economist; Miriam Wheeler, Goldman Sachs Global Head of Leveraged Finance; Evy Hambro, BlackRock Global Head of Thematic and Sector Investing  

--
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.
